execution_route.stage_1: Use the founder-approved BR-007 man frame as the edit target. With the explicit upper-body-only mask below, create only the undecorated BR-005 base garment volume: black body, plain black sleeves, hood with exact rose lining, white drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, and tonal ribbing. Do not create the chest silicone or side-body embroidery in this pass. Preserve face, pose, BR-007 shorts, legs, footwear, and every pixel outside the reviewed mask.

stage_1_edit_mask.protected_regions: Face/head opening and the full BR-007 shorts/legs/footwear area remain outside the edit zone.

execution_route.stage_2: Create two independent reviewed attachment mattes over the accepted base garment: one small wearer-right-chest matte for the molded silicone cluster and one wearer-left SIDE-BODY-ONLY matte for the longitudinal embroidery. Every arm, sleeve, forearm, shoulder, chest outside the silicone zone, pocket, and cuff pixel is excluded from the embroidery matte.
execution_route.stage_3: Apply the exact attachments only inside their independent mattes, then create and review a genuine alpha for the exact resulting male source. Reject any arm/sleeve intersection, opaque checkerboard, clipped limb, or altered BR-007 pixel.
execution_route.stage_4: Place the exact male alpha, founder-approved BR-004 woman alpha, exact hero graphic, and approved waterfront plate into one camera/floor/light contract. Restrict any generative integration pass to environment, edge spill, contact-shadow, and reflection regions; product/face pixels remain protected.
execution_route.provider_policy: Built-in image generation is not eligible for stage 1 because it exposes no explicit mask. A mask-capable edit route is mandatory. No provider call is allowed while this manifest is BLOCKED_PRE_PROVIDER.
